# Lower your storage and compute bill

Use the sections below when you want cheaper storage (compression, tiers, retention), lighter compute (sizing and usage), or Tiger Cloud billing context.

## I want to reduce…

- Reduce storage costs with compression
- Use [tiered storage](/learn/data-management/storage) for cold data
- Configure appropriate retention policies

## Compute costs

- Right-size your instance
- Monitor resource usage

## Tiger Cloud

- [Pricing and account management](/deploy/tiger-cloud/tiger-cloud-aws/pricing-and-account-management)

## See also

- [Columnar storage](/learn/columnar-storage): compression and Hypercore
- [Tiered storage](/learn/data-management/storage): move cold data to cheaper tiers
